en.description:
Build a world you can carry with you.

WatchBlocks is a pixel-art crafting and survival sandbox built for Apple Watch, iPhone, and iPad. Mine an endless block world, gather resources, craft tools and gear, grow food, explore varied biomes, battle creatures, and build something worth coming back to.

CHOOSE YOUR WAY TO PLAY

SURVIVAL

Gather wood, stone, ore, and food. Craft tools, weapons, armor, and machines. Explore forests, deserts, wastelands, snow, and volcanic regions as day turns to night. Discover structures, tame companions, fight dangerous mobs, and recover your belongings from gravestones when you fall.

CREATIVE

Build without survival limits. Use the Creative inventory, spawn creatures, fly through your creations, and shape an entire world around your ideas. [Requires Full Access]

DAILY MINI GAMES

Take on four daily challenges: Parkour, Dungeon Descent, Attack, and Excavate. Use the same worlds, blocks, mobs, and controls as the main game. Chase personal bests and Game Center leaderboard scores, then replay the last 30 days with Full Game.

CREATE YOUR OWN CONTENT

Design custom skins and make the game your own. Full Game unlocks Mod Creator, where you can build custom blocks, items, mobs, biomes, recipes, loot, textures, and playable mod packs. [Requires Full Access]

PLAY TOGETHER

Host or join multiplayer worlds over the local network, play with Game Center on supported Apple devices, or pair your iPhone and Apple Watch for Watch Co-op.

KEEP EXPLORING

Water flows, crops grow, worlds change with time, and every adventure can become something bigger. Sync your worlds across your Apple devices and keep building wherever you are.

START FREE

Play the core survival experience free. Try the Full Game free for 3 days, then unlock Creative Mode, unlimited worlds, custom world types, custom skins, Mod Creator, world settings, and more with a single purchase. No subscription.

versionHistory.releaseNotes: Fixed bugs
Fixed bugs
Bug fixes, and iPad support

What's new in v1.1:
- Creative mode: Enable when creating a new world. You can fly around, plus there's no health limiting you. More to come with this new game mode in the future
- Cotton: a new plant found in grasslands. Gives you cotton when you break, currently no use for it
- Ruined towers: Spawn randomly, contain chests at the top
- Auto break trees: when you get close to a tree, you will start to break it. Makes navigating your world easier. Toggle available for this
- Multiplayer with iPhone and Apple Watch is now clearly shown, not available for iPad
- Days last 5 minutes, nights last 2 minutes instead of the previous 2 minute days
- Option to disable haptics
- Plenty of bug fixes

What's new in v1.2:

This update brings major improvements to gameplay, visuals, and content across all devices.

New Features and Content

* New app icon
* Added world settings, allowing you to change game mode and other options while in a world
* Added workbench for crafting
* Added wood pickaxe
* Added new ore blocks: Coal, Iron, Copper, Gold, Diamond
* Added new flowers: Red, Blue, Yellow
* Added cotton block variants: White, Red, Blue, Yellow
* Added TNT, crafted with sulfur and cotton
* Added obsidian and water bucket (Creative only for now)
* Added volcanic biome with lava, sulfur, and volcanic stone
* Lava bucket available in Creative

Gameplay Improvements

* Game Mode system fully enabled
* Creative mode now includes many additional items
* Flying in Creative enabled via double jump
* No hearts displayed in Creative mode
* Bedrock can now be broken in Creative
* Increased reach for breaking blocks and balanced placement reach
* Fixed block reach in Survival and enabled unlimited reach in Creative
* Added build height limit
* Doors now require a two block high space to place
* Breaking grass now yields dirt
* Leaves are now passable
* Adjusted underwater gravity
* Apples are now more rare

Controls and UI

* Joystick now defaults to the right side on Apple Watch, with a new setting to choose side
* Added “drag to place” setting (Creative only)
* Updated joystick and jump button visuals
* Increased Apple Watch inventory view size
* Increased inventory size to 10 slots on iOS and iPadOS
* Updated inventory slot layout in portrait mode
* Fixed joystick related issues
* Fixed chest scrolling issue

Visual Updates

* New textures for multiple blocks and items, including grass, dirt, stone, ores, logs, sand, and farmland
* Improved sky appearance
* Fixed background rendering in empty spaces such as caves, ladders, and plants
* Improved visibility at the bottom of the world
* Updated slime appearance and got rid of blue slimes
* Items such as pickaxes and swords now appear in the player’s hand

World Generation and Balance

* Fixed ore generation
* Reduced cotton spawn rate and removed it from spawning inside trees
* Increased slime hitbox for easier combat

Performance

* General performance improvements and bug fixes

What’s New in WatchBlocks

Big update! This release adds new content, improvements, controller functionality, and lots of polish across the game.

New Features

* Chickens added
* Partial controller support added
* Sound effects and audio added
* Original music by Hunter Shoemaker added
* FPS counter added
* FPS cap setting added so you can choose your target frame rate
* Green cotton and sand bricks added
* Creative inventory categories added for easier browsing
* New world cloud sync system added across your Apple devices

Gameplay & Visual Improvements

* New pixel style font added
* Improved player appearance
* Equipped items and armor are now visible on your character
* New block breaking animation
* Better overall performance and stability

Fixes & Changes

* Improved world syncing
* Fixed inventory related issues
* Fixed chest related issues
* Corrected flipped hoe texture
* Watch to iPhone multiplayer has been temporarily removed while it is being improved and will return in a future update

And more improvements throughout the game!

What’s New in WatchBlocks

This update expands biome variety with new plants, new cotton colors, visual improvements, and performance enhancements across the game.

New Content

* Purple and Orange cotton added
* Purple Tulips added to the Badlands biome
* Lava Flowers added to Volcanic biomes

Visual Improvements

* Updated sulfur texture
* Updated diamond texture

Gameplay & UI Improvements

* Improved crafting responsiveness
* Renamed the “Misc” crafting tab to “Items” for better clarity

Performance

* General performance improvements and optimizations across the game

And more small improvements throughout WatchBlocks!

v1.3.2 — Light the Depths

This is a major survival expansion for WatchBlocks.

New in this update:
• Copper tools, armor, ingots, and weapons
• Achievements for Survival worlds
• Torches, cave lighting, and improved darkness
• Full controller support for iOS, iPadOS, and Mac
• Experimental iPhone-to-Apple Watch controller mode
• Beds, trapdoors, slime blocks, sulfur bricks, cactus bricks, and more
• Improved Badlands and Volcanic biomes
• Mice, meat drops, better farming, and survival balance changes
• New textures, UI improvements, and pause screen polish
• Major chunk crash fix and performance improvements

WatchBlocks v1.4: Temples & Dungeons

A major adventure update has arrived!

New Features
• Discover the Volcanic Temple and challenge the Skeleton King boss
• Explore Dungeons hidden throughout the world
• Find rare loot including Jump Boots, Climbing Claws, Slow Fall Charm, Temple Locator, and Lava Charm
• Customize your character with 4 new skins
• New enemy types: Skeletons and Fire Slimes
• New Glow Ore, Glow Ingots, Glow Blocks, and Glow Armor
• Volcanic Ores now generate in Volcanic Biomes
• Grow saplings and cotton seeds on farmland
• Added a trash slot for inventory management

World & Survival Improvements
• Improved combat system
• New achievements for dungeons, glow gear, and boss progression
• Multi-stage crop growth with offline farming
• Larger, rarer Volcanic Biomes
• Better day/night cycle with visible sun and stars
• Lava pools can now generate in caves
• Players now have 10 HP with a new health display

Quality of Life
• New sounds, particles, damage numbers, and death animations
• Improved inventory, crafting, and workbench interfaces
• Redesigned pause screen and world menus
• Better controller support across all platforms
• Improved cloud syncing
• Performance optimizations and bug fixes

Thank you for playing WatchBlocks!

WatchBlocks v1.4.1

A small update focused on quality-of-life improvements, progression, and customization.

A major update is already in development. Keep an eye out over the next few weeks for more details.

New Features
- Split-Screen Multiplayer: Connect two controllers to iPhone, iPad, or Mac and play WatchBlocks together on the same device
- Added the Tool Bench, used to upgrade and repair tools
- Added two new skins: Void Traveller and Cyber Ninja
- Added Dirt Bricks, crafted from 4 Dirt
- Added an experimental Retro Shader and Handheld Console mode in Settings
- Rare Slime Pockets can now generate in caves

Improvements
- Added a Create World button next to the Sync button on iPhone, iPad, and Mac
- Volcanic Temples now generate more frequently
- Chickens and Mice now have 3 health
- Chickens and Mice can now jump up blocks
- Wheat no longer spawns fully grown
- Refreshed the app icon with an updated look
- Added new sounds

WatchBlocks v1.4.2

A frosty new update has arrived, bringing snowy adventures, new enemies, and expanded device support!

New Features

* Added the Snow Biome
* New hostile enemy: Snowmen, which attack by throwing snowballs
* Added Snowballs, a new throwable weapon
* New blocks: Snow Grass and Ice
* Added Volume Sliders for improved audio control

Improvements

* Improved mob spawning behavior across the world
* WatchBlocks now supports iOS 15 + iPadOS 15 and later
* Various bug fixes and performance improvements

More content is on the way. Thanks for playing WatchBlocks!

WatchBlocks v1.5 - The Biggest Update Yet

WatchBlocks is now free to start! Explore, mine, craft, build, and survive for free, then unlock the complete experience anytime with a one-time purchase.

Free-to-Play

* WatchBlocks is now free to start.
* Free players can experience the core game with some features reserved for the Full Access upgrade, including saved worlds, Creative Mode, custom worlds, custom skins, mod creation, and Watch Console.

Multiplayer

* Play together with Game Center multiplayer (iPhone, iPad, and Mac).
* Host or join LAN multiplayer games.
* Team up with Watch Co-op using your iPhone and Apple Watch.

Create Your Own Content

* Create and share custom blocks, items, and biomes
* Design custom skins with the all-new Skin Editor, or choose from built-in skins.

New Gameplay

* Added the Slime Boss. Summon it with a Slime Summoner to earn the Slime Charm, which keeps slimes away.
* New electricity system with copper wires, power blocks, pulse lasers, and teleport plates.
* New Hammer tool lets you transform blocks into stairs and slabs.
* Gravestones now safely store your dropped items after death.
* Collections help you track every block, item, mob, and biome you’ve discovered.
* Added new achievements.
* Added stone doors.
* Added carrots with multi-stage farming.
* Explore the new Desert Shrine.
* Teleport to nearby structures with cheats enabled.
* Ore blocks can now be crafted into ingots.
* Added crafting recipes for Glow Blocks.
* Added Mechanical and Mobs tabs to the Creative Inventory.
* Spawn mobs directly from the Creative Inventory.

New Friends

* Meerkats now roam the desert and can be tamed as companions.
* Penguins have arrived in snowy biomes.

Gameplay Improvements

* You can now drag around to move instead of using the joystick
* Choose between Hold to Break or Tap to Break.
* Tap to Break now supports queued block breaking.
* Hold to Break now includes a precision magnifying lens.
* Hold items in your inventory to view descriptions.
* Mine blocks up to two blocks below the surface.
* Jump Boots now grant a double jump.
* Special items now work directly from your inventory.
* Improved Apple Watch controller support.
* Fixed an issue where trees generated with missing leaves.
* When in creative mode, you no longer fly by default

Building & World

* Improved camera field of view and default zoom.
* Water now flows and levels more naturally.
* Doors automatically face the correct direction when placed.

Interface

* Compatible Apple Watches now support up to 5 hotbar slots.
* Watch Console only shows if you have the Apple Watch version installed on a paired Apple Watch.
* Battery and time indicators are hidden during gameplay on iPhone and iPad.
* You can now increase text size
* Launch WatchBlocks even faster with a new Apple Watch complication.
* Completely redesigned interface across the entire game.
* Added a new Help menu.

Visuals & Audio

* Improved pixel font.
* Brand-new hand-pixelled icons.
* Better walking and swimming animations.
* Retextured many blocks, items, and tools.
* Captions: See any sounds being made, and get notified of where an enemy may be coming from. Caption in audio settings must be turned on
* Added lots of new music and sound effects.

As always, this update also includes numerous performance improvements, bug fixes, and polish throughout the game. Thank you for playing WatchBlocks!

WatchBlocks v1.5.1
This update focuses on polish, performance, and clarity, making the game feel noticeably smoother and more enjoyable across all devices.

What's New & Improved
* Much faster multiplayer: Significant speed improvements on Apple Watch and all other supported devices
* Being able to only tame one meerkat was kinda boring. You can now tame as many as you want!
* Better UI on small screens: World screen and interface now look sharper and more refined on smaller Apple Watches
* Broader optimizations: Game runs better on all devices, especially older models
* Fixed queue behavior: Queued blocks no longer cancel when you move away
* Clearer upgrade messaging: Improved text explaining what the full version includes
* Founder recognition: Founders now see clear, prominent text confirming their status

Thank you for playing! If you spot any issues, please let us know at formidablegamesstudio@gmail.com.
Enjoy the update.

WatchBlocks v1.5.2 - A Jim-iliar Update

New

* Added raccoons! Explore the world and discover these curious new creatures found in plains and forest biomes
* Raccoons can now be tamed with apples. They transform into something… familiar…
* Added a new hidden achievement.

Improvements

* Performance improvements and bug fixes.
* Minor gameplay and UI polish.
* Bigger updates coming soon!

v1.5.3 - Worlds Worth Keeping

What's New:
* Free players can now create up to three worlds. Additional worlds require an upgrade.
* Added pigs.
* Added snow blocks and snow bricks.
* Added new water and lava buckets textures
* Added diamond, iron, copper, gold, glow, coal, and slime blocks textures
* Added new glow-item textures.

Inventory Improvements:
* Reorganized the Creative inventory
* Added collapsible categories for related blocks, including ores, grass, bricks, and cotton.
* Apple Watch players can now use up to 10 inventory slots.

Improvements and Fixes:
* Improved visuals and overall performance.
* Fixed an FPS issue.
* Fixed Game Center stat reporting on Apple Watch.
* Updated the leaderboard title to “TOP 50 PLAYERS - Blocks Broken.”
* Random player searches now stop correctly instead of running indefinitely.

WatchBlocks v1.5.4 - No Bugs, Yes Gravity

What's New: 
* Gravity block: When powered, makes your gravity the opposite
* Power block is now passthrough (able to walk through it)
* 4x better performance across all platforms
* FPS bug fixed (for real this time)
* Removed campsite structure
* Fixed a ton of bugs

What's new in WatchBlocks v1.5.5:
* 4 Mini Game Modes
* Birds that fly around
* Dark mode icon
* 5 new skins
* Better mod creator
* Better skin creator
* Better Watch console
* New feedback form
* Free players can now get community mods with CraftBits
* Text size on watch by default is 140%
* Fixed a lot of bugs, and made the game run smoother on lower end devices

WatchBlocks v1.5.6 - I Like Turtles:
* Turtles added
* Added the following items/blocks: turtle shells, feathers, black flower, black cotton, rocks, dead shrub, eggs
* Not all of these items are useable yet, but some will gain a purpose in future updates
* Updated slow fall charm texture
* Can now see everyone who is hosting globally
* Made small visual improvements
* Background renderer should be more accurate
* Performance and bug fixes

WatchBlocks v1.5.7 - The Launcher Update
* Added the Launcher, which can launch eggs, snowballs, diamonds, TNT, and turtle shells
* Eggs deal 1 damage on direct hits
* Snowballs no longer deal damage, but now hit more directly and briefly slow mobs
* Diamonds instantly defeat mobs on impact
* TNT explodes when it hits a block or mob
* Turtle shells deal 1 damage on impact, bounce back and forth for 15 seconds, then disappear

What else is new:
* Improved the hotbar: scroll horizontally through up to 10 items on smaller screens (even Apple Watch!)
* Free users can now switch between different skins. Creating custom skins still requires Full Access
* Clouds now show up in the background
* Skins have new looks to match more with the world
* Skeletons have a new look to match more with the world
* Added new achievements and updated collections
* Removed CraftBits, all community mods are now free
* Changed momentum physics
* Fixed an issue preventing some flowers from generating
* Reduced sound delays

WatchBlocks v1.5.8
- Fixed some collection bugs
- Fixed slime launched
- Fixed background issue
